title: Add 20 Vrat Kathayen, Full Ramayan, Mahabharat & Krishna Leela with Narration

requirements.text: Add all 20 Vrat Kathayen to the static katha data in frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts. Each katha must include: category 'Vrat', appropriate deity name, full Hindi title, full Hindi narrative text (complete story, not truncated), and approved status. The 20 vrat kathayen should cover major Hindu fasts including: Ekadashi, Pradosh, Somvar (Shivji), Mangalvar (Hanumanji), Budhvar (Ganeshji), Brihaspativar (Vishnu/Guruvar), Shukravar (Santoshi Mata/Devi), Shanivaar (Shani Dev), Navratri Vrat, Kartik Vrat, Ahoi Ashtami, Hariyali Teej, Hartalika Teej, Karva Chauth, Vat Savitri, Jivitputrika (Jitiya), Solah Somvar, Satyanarayan Vrat, Sakat Chauth, and Janmashtami Vrat.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly 20 vrat kathayen entries exist in kathaData.ts under the 'Vrat' category
Each katha has a full Hindi narrative (minimum 300 words per story)
All 20 appear in the Kathayen page under the Vrat filter tab
Each entry has a unique ID, correct category, deity, and title

requirements.text: Expand the Ramayan content in frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts to include the full Ramayan with all major kandas: Bal Kand, Ayodhya Kand, Aranya Kand, Kishkindha Kand, Sundar Kand, Lanka Kand (Yuddha Kand), and Uttar Kand. Each kanda should be a separate katha entry with category 'Puranik', deity 'Ram', full Hindi title, and complete Hindi narrative text covering all major events of that kanda.
acceptanceCriteria: All 7 Ramayan kandas are present as individual katha entries
Each kanda entry has full narrative text in Hindi covering major events
All Ramayan entries appear under the Puranik category filter
Entries are ordered sequentially (Bal Kand through Uttar Kand)

requirements.text: Expand the Mahabharat content in frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts to include all major parvas as separate katha entries: Adi Parva, Sabha Parva, Vana Parva, Virata Parva, Udyoga Parva, Bhishma Parva (including Bhagavad Gita summary), Drona Parva, Karna Parva, Shalya Parva, Sauptika Parva, Stri Parva, Shanti Parva, and Swargarohana Parva. Each parva should have category 'Puranik', deity 'Krishna' or appropriate deity, full Hindi title, and complete Hindi narrative.
acceptanceCriteria: All major Mahabharat parvas exist as individual katha entries
Each parva entry contains complete Hindi narrative of major events
All Mahabharat entries appear under the Puranik category filter
Bhishma Parva entry includes a summary of the Bhagavad Gita

requirements.text: Add a dedicated 'Krishna Leela' category section with at least 10 Krishna Leela stories in frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts. Stories should include: Janmotsav (birth), Putana Vadh, Makhan Chor Leela, Govardhan Parvat Dharana, Kaliya Nag Daman, Raas Leela, Kans Vadh, Sudama Milan, Draupadi Cheerharan and Krishna's intervention, and Kurukshetra Geeta Updesh. Each entry must have category 'Krishna Leela', deity 'Krishna', full Hindi title, and complete Hindi narrative.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 10 Krishna Leela stories exist in kathaData.ts
All entries have category 'Krishna Leela'
Krishna Leela tab/filter on the Kathayen page shows these stories
Each story has complete Hindi narrative text

requirements.text: Ensure the Kathayen page (frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx) has a 'Krishna Leela' filter tab alongside the existing All, Puranik, and Vrat tabs. The tab should filter and display only Krishna Leela category kathayen. The tab label should be 'कृष्ण लीला' in Hindi.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'कृष्ण लीला' tab is visible on the Kathayen page
Selecting the tab filters the katha list to only Krishna Leela entries
The tab integrates visually with the existing filter tab row
Tab is active-highlighted when selected

requirements.text: Add prominent narration controls to the KathaDetail page (frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx) using the existing useSpeechNarration hook. The narration UI must include: a Play/Pause toggle button, a Stop button, and a visible 'Narration' label. When narration is active, highlight the currently narrated section if possible. Prefer Hindi voice for Hindi text. Show a tooltip or label indicating the narration language. The narration controls should be placed in a sticky or easily accessible position (e.g., top of content or floating bottom bar).
acceptanceCriteria: KathaDetail page shows Play, Pause, and Stop narration buttons
Clicking Play begins text-to-speech of the katha text using useSpeechNarration
Clicking Pause pauses narration; clicking Play/Resume resumes from where it paused
Clicking Stop ends narration and resets state
Narration controls are accessible without scrolling (sticky or floating placement)
Hindi voice is used when available via the existing hook
Narration works for Vrat Kathayen, Ramayan, Mahabharat, and Krishna Leela entries

constraints: All katha content must be in Hindi (Devanagari script) as the primary language
Use the existing useSpeechNarration hook for all narration functionality — do not introduce a new audio/TTS library
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
All new katha data must be added to frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts following existing data structure and TypeScript types
Maintain the existing Kathayen page UI layout and filter tab design pattern
nonGoals: External audio file hosting or MP3 narration — only Web Speech API (TTS) is in scope
Backend seeding of new katha entries (frontend static data is sufficient)
English translations of new katha content (Hindi only unless existing pattern supports both)
Adding new pages or routes beyond what already exists
Video content or animation for Krishna Leela stories
